title: Starting violin at six with a French opera teacher
summary: His family was not musical; he began violin at six with the assistant conductor of the French opera, studying six years.

When did you start in music? What was the first instrument you started on?

My first instrument was violin, which was my major. I started on that when I was six. And I started with a French teacher who was assistant conductor of the French opera in New Orleans. What was his name? By the name of Francois Kakel. That's K-E-R-K-E-L. I studied with him six years.
